name: Ōda (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ōda city emblem in maroon: a ring with a pointed top enclosing a stylised arrowhead.
history: Municipal flag of Ōda, a city in Shimane Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 April 2006; the emblem dates from 30 June 1954.

features.role: Ōda city emblem — a ring with a pointed top enclosing a stylised arrowhead
